environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted applied via Kyverno ClusterPolicy (not native PSA) that validates against CEL expressions matching Pod Security Standards 'restricted' profile. The Kyverno policy includes rules validate-privileged-containers and validate-hostpath-volumes with validationFailureAction: Enforce. Additionally, an OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate K8sPSPHostFilesystem is instantiated with allowedHostPaths set to empty array. Node-level AppArmor profile 'k8s-restricted' loaded via DaemonSet denies write to paths outside /tmp and /var/log within containers. The combination requires all three controls to pass for pod admission.
